summary.note: This result demonstrates that Aegis detects all 20 tested mutation operators. It does not claim detection of all possible implementation bugs.

mutants.name: skip_agent_match
mutants.description: Bypass agent identity check — any agent matches any policy
mutants.expected_detection: DENY for unauthorized agent accessing wrong tool/action
mutants.realistic_defect: developer accidentally removes agent ID comparison

mutants.name: substitute_file_identity
mutants.description: Forge file tool identity — all file requests use hr-agent identity

mutants.name: skip_action_check
mutants.description: Allow any action for any authorized tool
mutants.realistic_defect: action parameter not checked in policy evaluation

mutants.name: skip_min_amount
mutants.description: Ignore minimum amount constraint

mutants.name: skip_max_amount
mutants.description: Ignore maximum amount constraint

mutants.name: missing_parameter_fails_open
mutants.description: Allow request when required parameter is missing

mutants.name: unsupported_type_fails_open
mutants.description: Allow request with unsupported parameter type (e.g., boolean amount)

mutants.name: case_insensitive_currency
mutants.description: Accept 'usd' when only 'USD' is allowed

mutants.name: max_boundary_off_by_one
mutants.description: Accept amount at max_amount boundary (should be exclusive)

mutants.name: min_boundary_off_by_one
mutants.description: Accept amount below min_amount boundary (should be exclusive)

mutants.name: raw_path_prefix
mutants.description: Use raw string prefix instead of filepath.Clean
mutants.expected_detection: DENY for path traversal after canonicalization
mutants.realistic_defect: path not cleaned before prefix check

mutants.name: skip_path_constraint
mutants.description: Skip path prefix check entirely

mutants.name: raw_path_prefix_alt
mutants.description: Alternative raw path prefix check (different code path)
mutants.realistic_defect: duplicate path validation code with bug

mutants.name: skip_duplicate_create
mutants.description: Allow duplicate payment creation (skip state check)
mutants.realistic_defect: state check not performed before create

mutants.name: skip_refund_replay
mutants.description: Allow double refund (skip replay detection)

mutants.name: allow_refund_without_create
mutants.description: Allow refund for non-existent transaction

mutants.name: global_transaction_identity
mutants.description: Use single global transaction ID for all payments
mutants.realistic_defect: transaction ID not extracted from params

mutants.name: weaken_state_reservation
mutants.description: Skip state reservation before downstream execution
mutants.expected_detection: duplicate execution or invalid state transition

mutants.name: unknown_tool_allowed
mutants.description: Allow requests to unknown tools
mutants.realistic_defect: default allow instead of default deny

mutants.name: malformed_fails_open
mutants.description: Allow malformed JSON requests to proceed
